author: AlexisGen
body: Okay, so I log on. The first thing I notice is the new server hub. I personally think its great, the parkour and everything. But it reminds me of another server's hub. Anyways, I go to play Nexus but realize there are different games. I'm a bit upset that they removed Nexus as I was about to prestige. I go into CTW and ask questions of whats happened. I find out that Nexus is still here but they removed XP. I think the new games will attract more players, definitely. But I kind of like how the community was smaller and we were all closer friends and logged on each day to just kinda chill, (which we totally still can do) its just, it benefits both sides, the staff, and players. more players, good for staff (kinda) more games, good for players. I hope I'm not the only one who kinda misses the older version of Avicus. I totally love the new games but I miss the simplicity of the server, its a bit trickier now but it'll grow on me. This is just my opinion. This is overall a great server and I will always be in love with it.
